_comment: Touge Nights' invitations (see docs/modding.md, "events"). trackId: the pass a club runs it on when the player has
that track (mount_akina_2017, nishi_izu_skyline: community tracks); without it, any road track of theirs (step 42
phase 2: a format's own tracks). Money in 2002 dollars.

events.name: Lake Road Downhill
events.description: Friday night, the lake road closed off by the clubs. One run down, first to the bottom takes the pot.

events.name: Hachiroku Cup
events.description: Light Toyotas only, under two hundred horsepower. Momentum and nerve, no turbos.

events.name: Akagi Drift Meet
events.description: The car park's drift meet: tandem runs judged on angle, speed and style. The crowd decides who comes back next week.

events.name: Budget Battle
events.description: Cars worth less than fifteen thousand. Proof that the driver matters more than the wallet.

events.name: Turbo Night
events.description: Two hundred and fifty horsepower and up. The tuners bring their dyno sheets and their egos.

events.name: Midnight Time Attack
events.description: The shop's own time attack: three flying laps, best one counts, ghosts so nobody gets hurt.

events.name: Grand Drift Battle
events.description: The prefecture's drift final. Win it and the whole mountain knows your name.

reward.specialItemDescription: A set of race camshafts for your engine

events.name: Pink Slip Downhill
events.description: Loser walks home. No prize but the other car.
